deck_title: Enterprise Live-Commerce Real-Time Video Pipeline: StreamDiffusion Batch Pipe + TensorRT + Similarity Cache (l_frame = l_0/(1+u), 1.0000x 30fps Lock) vs Naive 50-Step Per-Frame Diffusion Stall

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Enterprise Real-Time Live-Commerce StreamDiffusion & TensorRT pipeline evaluation (combining 4-step LCM/ADD consistency distillation, Stream-Batch diagonal step pipelining, Residual CFG, TAESD fast codecs, and Stochastic Similarity Filtering so normalized per-frame latency l_stream(u) = l_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking T_active / T_stream = 1.0000x at 30fps across all 17 stages u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive per-frame 50-step dual-CFG diffusion (which stalls at <1fps and boils background textures, inflating latency ratio by 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stages) and 64-window temporal latent quadrature.

cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Enterprise 24x7 e-commerce livestreaming studios (TikTok Live / Taobao Live), interactive flagship store LED installations, and real-time VTuber stage backgrounds
Combining 4-step LCM/ADD consistency distillation, Stream-Batch diagonal pipelining, Residual CFG (R-CFG), and TAESD on TensorRT FP16/FP8 engines
Eliminating inter-frame background boiling via fixed-seed noise anchoring and Stochastic Similarity Filtering (<25ms end-to-end frame latency)
not_for: Offline 60-second cinematic TVC master rendering where 2-minute cloud queue latency is acceptable
